mapper.select: select id,eval_run_id as evalRunId,deployment_ref as deploymentRef,policy_version as policyVersion,outcome,reasons_json as reasonsJson,baseline_requests as baselineRequests,canary_requests as canaryRequests,canary_failures as canaryFailures,critical_findings as criticalFindings,infrastructure_errors as infrastructureErrors,p95_latency_ms as p95LatencyMs,average_cost as averageCost,created_by as createdBy,created_at as createdAt from eval_canary_assessment where eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} order by created_at desc limit #{limit}
